rationale: C05 supplies a compact and closely parallel drafting pattern: a recommendation is acknowledged, expressly approved, and followed by authorization or direction to implement the recommended action. The child uses the same sequence and materially similar language, approving recommendations and directing the Secretary to incorporate them into program administration. C13 has a comparable approval-and-proceed formula but weaker verbal correspondence. C15 concerns the same voluntary crude-oil import program, yet does not provide as close a drafting template.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have approved the recommendations embodied in the Supplementary Report ... I direct you to incorporate these recommendations in the administration of the voluntary oil import program.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The action which you recommend meets with my approval. Accordingly, I hereby authorize you to arrange for and carry out the transfer which you recommend.
shared_material.explanation: Both memoranda follow the distinctive sequence of identifying recommendations, expressly approving them, and immediately directing or authorizing the recipient to implement them.
